name: – § 3 – Am 62
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 3. Acknowledges reports that indicate attempts by the Moroccan authorities to incite border crossings through misinformation; condemns the Moroccan authorities for using people’s lives, including those of minors and its own citizens, to pursue international interests; emphasises that people who crossed the border must not be reduced to instruments of geopolitical strategy or treated as a mere means to an end, and that they are victims of this situation;
